questions.stem: One byte of an IPv4 address is 10101000 in binary. What is it in decimal?
A web cache answers 80% of requests in 10 ms. The other 20% go to the origin server and take 110 ms. What is the average response time in ms?
questions.explain: Weight each case by its share: 0.8 × 10 + 0.2 × 110 = 8 + 22 = 30 ms.

questions.stem: Which transport protocol sets up a connection first and retransmits lost segments?
questions.explain: TCP is connection-oriented and reliable: it uses a handshake and retransmits lost data. UDP just sends datagrams with no such guarantees.

questions.stem: How many messages make up the TCP connection set-up handshake?
questions.explain: The handshake is SYN, then SYN-ACK, then ACK, which is three messages.
